data.title: About Dominick
bio: As a life long resident of New Jersey, Dominick was born and raised in Hudson County and moved to Old Bridge with his wife and 3 kids in 2018.  Dominick has worked as an accountant in the audit field for the last 7 years so the transition to Real Estate came naturally.

Dominick focuses on working to fit the home of your dreams into any budget for ambitious buyers.  For sellers moving onto the next endeavors, Dominick makes sure to maximize your profit through creative marketing and networking throughout the entire state!
In his spare time, Dominick spends time with his young family at the Jersey Shore and is also an avid runner and golfer!
